t: Three claims about what giving does
a: مَا نَقَصَتْ صَدَقَةٌ مِنْ مَالٍ وَمَا زَادَ اللَّهُ عَبْدًا بِعَفْوٍ إِلاَّ عِزًّا وَمَا تَوَاضَعَ أَحَدٌ لِلَّهِ إِلاَّ رَفَعَهُ اللَّهُ
m: Charity does not decrease wealth. No one forgives except that Allah increases him in honour. And no one humbles himself for Allah except that Allah raises him.
